Spectacular all around!
Feb 2019
After a madness at the airport to get through immigration, I got to my hotel and was looking for a place to get dinner for my only night in HCMC.

I couldn’t be happier with my decision to go here. The food was wonderful, the staff was so friendly, and they were super accommodating to my vegan diet.

Oh, and how can I forget...the view! I ate my dinner looking out on the city from a 7th floor view with the breeze blowing by. 

Getting to this place is a bit tricky, but worth the effort. There’s a corner building that says “Rice Terrace Restaurant” on the side of it. Enter the lobby (you’ll feel like you’re not in the right place) and tell the person at the desk you’re there for the restaurant. She’ll check if there’s space for you and if so, point you to the elevator! Seems like it might be worth calling ahead to reserve a spot on weekends. I walked in on a Wednesday at 8pm and was luckily able to get a table right away.

Give this place a try! You won’t be disappointed.

A really warm welcome followed by great food with a great view
Jan 2019 • Couples
Went for dinner here after having bad service in our hotel the night before and the difference was massive.

We were warmly greeted as we arrived and given a table with an outstanding view over Ho Chi Minh City.

All served up with friendly service in good time - and you can see your food being freshly cooked.
